name.description: Unique name for the auto attendant.

phoneNumber.description: Auto attendant phone number.  Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

extension.description: Auto attendant extension.  Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

firstName.description: First name defined for an auto attendant. This field has been deprecated. Please use `directLineCallerIdName` and `dialByName` instead.

lastName.description: Last name defined for an auto attendant. This field has been deprecated. Please use `directLineCallerIdName` and `dialByName` instead.

alternateNumbers.description: Alternate numbers defined for the auto attendant.

languageCode.description: Announcement language code for the auto attendant.

businessSchedule.description: Business hours defined for the auto attendant.

holidaySchedule.description: Holiday defined for the auto attendant.

extensionDialing.description: Extension dialing setting. If the values are not set default will be set as `ENTERPRISE`.

nameDialing.description: Name dialing setting. If the values are not set default will be set as `ENTERPRISE`.

timeZone.description: Time zone defined for the auto attendant.

businessHoursMenu.description: Business hours menu defined for the auto attendant.

afterHoursMenu.description: After hours menu defined for the auto attendant.

directLineCallerIdName.description: Settings for the direct line caller ID name to be shown for this auto attendant.

dialByName.description: Sets or clears the name to be used for dial by name functions. To clear the `dialByName`, the attribute must be set to null or empty string. Characters of `%`,  `+`, `\`, `"` and Unicode characters are not allowed.
